title: Glaucoma surgery
what: The surgeon makes a new path for fluid to drain from the eye. This lowers the pressure inside the eye.
why: For glaucoma, when drops and laser do not lower the pressure enough.
duration: surgery usually takes 45 to 90 minutes; you usually go home the same day or after 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Diabetes, heart disease, and blood pressure
If you had surgery on this eye before

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a checkup with a general doctor. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Drops
prepare.text: Drops are usually continued until surgery, but some may be stopped. Only as your doctor says.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: If you have general anesthesia, the clinic will tell you when to stop eating.

bring: A list of your medicines and eye drops
steps: Drops are put in, and numbing medicine is given near the eye
Sometimes you get a sedative or general anesthesia
A small device holds your eyelids open
The surgeon makes a small channel under the upper eyelid
Your eye is covered with a patch
feel: During surgery, you feel pressure but not pain
Afterward, it feels like something is in the eye, and the eye is red
Vision may be blurry for the first few weeks
after: Use drops exactly as scheduled. They are often frequent and needed for a long time
You will see the doctor often, especially in the first weeks
Do not rub your eye or lift heavy things
Sometimes stitches are adjusted or removed at a visit
Only your doctor can stop glaucoma drops in this eye
red_flags: Severe eye pain, nausea, or vomiting: see a doctor right away
Pus or strong redness, especially weeks after surgery: see a doctor right away
A severe headache with eye pain: call emergency services

faq.q: Will surgery bring my vision back?
faq.a: No. Vision lost to glaucoma does not come back. Surgery helps keep what is left.
Sometimes not, sometimes yes. The doctor will decide based on your eye pressure.

reminders.text: Glaucoma surgery tomorrow. Use your drops as the doctor said. Bring someone with you.
